## Seagate sustains pricing power as gross margins hold near three-year highs

Seagate's margin durability near multi-year peaks is a positive cycle signal for HDD storage; if AI inference and data archival continue to drive volume, pricing power could persist — the key watch item is any sign of supply normalization that could compress ASPs.

- STX is sustaining pricing power with margins near three-year highs, per the coverage
- Suggests a healthy HDD storage cycle characterized by disciplined supply and solid demand
- Elevated margins signal cycle longevity rather than an early deterioration pattern
- AI data generation and storage demand are likely underpinning the volume environment
